competing_explanation: The policy may have changed to a different return window, may distinguish standard from non-standard items, or may impose exceptions such as opened, final-sale, or special-category items.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items.
refutation_criterion: Evidence shows the current standard-item full-refund window is not 30 days, or that the 30-day window applies only to non-standard items, requires conditions, or has been changed.
